name: Rod of Lordly Might

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Paralyze
powers.text: Arm it (once per dawn): the next creature you hit makes a DC 17 Strength save or is Paralyzed for 1 minute.

powers.name: Terrify
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): creatures of your choice within 30 ft make a DC 17 Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute.

powers.name: Drain Life
powers.text: Arm it (once per dawn): the next creature you hit makes a DC 17 Con save or takes 4d6 Necrotic, and you regain half.

powers.name: Change form
powers.text: Bonus Action: the rod becomes a fiery blade (like a Flame Tongue), a battleaxe, a spear or a mace again (all +3).

summary: +3 mace that becomes a flaming blade, axe or spear; once a day each: Paralyze, Terrify and Drain Life.
text: This rod has a flanged head, and it functions as a magic Mace that grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. The rod has properties associated with six different buttons that are set in a row along the haft. It has three other properties as well. Six Buttons. You can press one of the rod's six buttons as a Bonus Action: a fiery blade sprouts from the end opposite the rod's flanged head (the rod functions as a Flame Tongue longsword, keeping its +3); the rod becomes a magic Battleaxe or Spear with the same bonus; or it becomes a climbing pole, a battering ram, or a compass and depth gauge. Paralyze. When you hit a creature with a melee attack using the rod, you can force the target to make a DC 17 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the Paralyzed condition for 1 minute; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Terrify. While holding the rod, you can take a Magic action to force each creature you can see within 30 feet of you to make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Drain Life. When you hit a creature with a melee attack using the rod, you can force the target to make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes an extra 4d6 Necrotic damage, and you regain a number of Hit Points equal to half this Necrotic damage. Once you use one of these three properties, you can't use it again until the next dawn.
